title: Messi vs Ronaldo
shortAnswer: Messi is widely regarded as the more naturally gifted player with superior dribbling and playmaking, while Ronaldo is celebrated for his athleticism, goal-scoring consistency, and aerial dominance. Messi has won 8 Ballon d'Or awards to Ronaldo's 5.
verdict: Both are all-time greats. Messi edges it for overall ability and the 2022 World Cup, while Ronaldo's longevity and Champions League record is unmatched.

lines.hook: Lionel Messi or Cristiano Ronaldo? The numbers settle it.
lines.tape: Five categories. One winner. Here is how they actually compare.
rounds: Lionel Messi takes ballon d'or awards.
